newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon sets 320-340p for Norwich.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon sets 320-340p for Norwich.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Thursday it estimated the fair value of insurance group Norwich Union, set to float on June 16, between 320p to 340p making it "attractive" compared with other insurance stocks.
This compares with a range of 335-345p on Thursday, indicated by bookmaker City Index and 342-350p from IG Index.

"The indicative strike price range of 240p to 290p now looks conservative in relation to other stocks and we consider fair value to be in the range of 320p to 340p", Salomon Brothers said as it initiated coverage of Norwich.

Norwich Union shares looked attractive relative to Legal & General Group Plc and Prudential Corp which had a good run in recent month. Even a post-flotation price of 380p would not look excessively stretched, Salomon said.
"A 35 percent premium to embedded value is not demanding", the report said.
Salomon said it expected an attractive pricing for Norwich, UK's third largest life insurer and fourth largest general insurer.
The domestic life insurance business was Norwich's key strength while the non-life business was, although with a critical mass, heavily exposed to the competitive motor business.
The Norwich flotation is expected to raise around 1.75 billion stg.
